name: space.vectornest/feeproof
title: Feeproof — 3PL Invoice Audit & Billing Rules
description: Audit 3PL invoices & contracts via API key, or query 18 3PL billing guides & rules free.

tools.name: list_3pl_providers
tools.description: List or search all 18 3PL providers tracked by Feeproof with public billing summaries, dispute windows, and guide URLs.

query.description: Optional search filter matching provider name, slug, or terms.

tools.name: get_3pl_provider_guide
tools.description: Retrieve full published rate tables, invoice audit checks, dispute clock, and accessorial playbook links for one 3PL provider.

providerSlug.description: Provider slug such as shipbob, shipmonk, flexport-deliverr, stord, or fulfyld.

tools.name: search_3pl_fee_playbooks
tools.description: Query Feeproof's 18 x 10 fee audit playbooks (audit formulas, invoice labels, contract defenses, evidence checklists, and dispute letter templates).

feeSlug.description: Optional fee category slug (e.g. dimensional-weight, storage-aged-inventory, uro-unidentified-receiving, minimum-spend-shortfall).

query.description: Optional keyword matching fee labels, triggers, formulas, or FAQs.

tools.name: compare_3pl_providers
tools.description: Compare two 3PL providers side by side across price disclosure, billing cadence, monthly minimums, storage snapshots, peak rules, and dispute windows.

pairSlug.description: Curated comparison slug such as shipbob-vs-shipmonk or fulfyld-vs-simpl-fulfillment.

providerA.description: First provider slug (used with providerB if pairSlug is omitted).

tools.name: calculate_dim_weight
tools.description: Compute carrier dimensional weight and rounded billable weight from box dimensions and actual weight using carrier or contract divisors.

length.description: Longest side length (inches for imperial, cm for metric).

actualWeight.description: Actual scale weight (lb for imperial, kg for metric).

divisor.description: DIM divisor. Defaults to standard carrier divisor from Feeproof config (139 imperial, 5000 metric).

tools.name: quick_check_3pl_invoice
tools.description: Run Feeproof's deterministic checks (duplicates R1, new fees R3, line math MATH, fee spikes R13) on a known CSV/PDF 3PL invoice without storing files.

currency.description: The currency the invoices are in, as a three-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD.

base64.description: The file's bytes, base64 encoded: a CSV or a PDF.

number.description: The invoice number printed on the invoice.

total.description: The total printed on the invoice, such as 1234.50.

month.description: The month the invoice covers, as yyyy-MM.

invoices.description: The invoices to check. Earlier months give the checks something to compare a later one with.
